decisions.what: Pits are entered only by force; knockback is the force. (FlowWorks side, the reason this mod exists.)

decisions.words: 1:1 totally. Even better if they can bounce inelastically off walls and rotate while they fly.

decisions.speaker: owner
decisions.words: 3:Each gas unit that ignites should create its own weak explosion that then whooshes along, detonating each gas cloud along the entire pattern. The backwash should scatter items not just in the cloud but within the radius of any of the individual explosions. Like 3:3 but I want to make sure each of the individual gas clumps gets it, not just "the centroid of the large gas cloud"
decisions.what: Igniting gas chains clump by clump; each clump makes its own weak explosion that scatters goods in its own radius, inside or outside the gas. Never one centroid blast.

decisions.speaker: owner
decisions.by_card: Is this the mod? -> Approve as written
decisions.what: The root text is approved word for word.

decisions.speaker: owner
decisions.by_card: Which explosions throw things? -> All harmful explosions
decisions.what: Bombs, grenades and mortars throw at full strength, fire and incendiary blasts at half, and every damaging explosion from any other mod throws too.

decisions.speaker: owner
decisions.by_card: Ordinary shelves don't protect. Does anything? -> (1) with a write-in
decisions.what: Closed containers protect what is inside them; open shelves, racks and tables do not; the container itself may be shoved a little.
decisions.words: (1) but the closed containers may themselves get shoved a bit

decisions.speaker: owner
decisions.by_card: Should a shield belt stop its wearer being thrown? -> Yes, costs extra charge
decisions.what: A shield belt that absorbs the blast absorbs the throw and drains extra charge (as built).

decisions.speaker: owner
decisions.by_card: How lively is the scatter? -> C, wild
decisions.what: Goods throw about 1.6 times as far, spin fast and rebound off walls until spent, keeping about 70% of their speed each rebound. People still stop dead at a wall and take the hit.

decisions.speaker: owner
decisions.by_card: What does a gas clump's small blast do besides scatter goods? -> B, shove 1 cell
decisions.what: A gas clump burst shoves a person one cell, with no damage, at most once every 2 seconds per person; gas bursts never break pit covers.

decisions.speaker: owner
decisions.by_card: A blast hits more goods than can fly smoothly. What happens to the extra? -> All of them fly
decisions.what: Every good a blast reaches flies; there is no overflow that stays or hops. The cost is engineered and proven on a mortar barrage and a long gas chain.

decisions.speaker: owner
decisions.by_card: Do flying goods hurt people they hit? -> Light knock, heavy only
decisions.what: A heavy flying stack that hits a person gives a small blunt hit and a stagger; light goods pass by.

decisions.speaker: owner
decisions.by_card: Which gas goes off clump by clump? -> 2, with a write-in
decisions.what: Our existing gases are tagged flammable where they fit, the Cauldron's gas among them; this mod adds no gas source of its own.
decisions.words: 2 and remember the gas in the Cauldron

decisions.speaker: agent
decisions.delegated: implementation detail of a ruled behaviour
decisions.what: A container counts as closed when it hides what it stores: crates, lockers, refrigerators, deep storage and hoppers (any storage building that does not draw its contents, plus an opt-in tag). Shelves, racks, tables, pallets and stockpile floors are open. Census of every storage def on the owner's list is part of RIMMANDRAKE_LIMIT_KNOCKBACK_STORAGE_CLOSED.

decisions.speaker: agent
decisions.what: 'Shoved a bit': a closed 1x1 container whose mass is under the mass limit slides one cell straight away from the blast if that cell is free and standable, contents inside; anything larger, or with no free cell, only jolts in place (a short visual shake). A container is never shoved into a pit, through a wall or onto a pawn.

decisions.speaker: agent
decisions.delegated: default value of a ruled behaviour
decisions.what: Other mods' damaging explosions default to 100% (the setting stays; its default moves from 0%); fire-type damage 50%; EMP, smoke, stun, extinguish and tox gas stay 0, because they are not harmful blasts (tox gas harms by its gas, not its blast). Any weapon can still be tamed per weapon.

decisions.speaker: agent
decisions.what: 'Heavy' means a flying stack of 10 kg or more; it deals 2 to 5 blunt damage scaled by mass and speed, staggers the pawn for about half a second and stops dead; under 10 kg it flies past. Value in Mod Settings.

decisions.speaker: agent
decisions.what: Agent census of every gas our mods spawn (TheForge, Scarlands' bileworm gas, EnvironmentalHazards, the Cauldron's gas); each one that should burn gets an opt-in flammable tag (a DefModExtension), the census table cites why. A mod not loaded simply contributes no tagged gas.

decisions.speaker: agent
decisions.what: A gas clump burst has radius 1.9, throws goods up to 2 cells (wild tuning applies), shoves people per his ruling, and is capped at one burst per clump cell; the chain advances with the fire front, not all at once.

decisions.speaker: agent
decisions.what: A gas shove deals no damage, so a shield belt never triggers on it and loses no charge.

decisions.speaker: agent
decisions.delegated: test numbers for a ruled proof
decisions.what: All goods fly by pooled carriers drawn in one batch; the proof is a 6-shell mortar barrage into a 10x10 full stockpile and a 40-cell gas chain, each keeping the game at normal speed without a frame over 50 ms on the owner's machine (advisory until calibrated).

failure_modes: It looks like teleporting, not a blast: goods blink to new cells under a dust puff, so the scatter he asked to watch (flying, spinning, bouncing loot) never happens, and every row reads green.

It looks green but isn't: the live scenes were last green 2026-10-06 on a staged site with the old rules (shelf exemption, instant items); since then his 2026-11-10 rulings and the gas chain exist only on paper, so in a real raid the mod may not match what he ruled and nothing he walks would show which.

The spectacle costs the game: a mortar into a stockpile, or a gas cloud going off clump by clump, spawns dozens of flying stacks at once; either the game stutters or the caps silently leave most goods unmoved, and both read to him as broken.

root.text: Every blast in RimWorld now throws what it hits. A mortar shell beside a colonist hurls them three cells straight away from it, clean over sandbags, until a wall stops them hard; anything light goes too, so loose goods and corpses fly through the air, spinning and rebounding off walls, and no open shelf keeps them safe. When gas catches, it goes off clump by clump, each small burst scattering whatever lies near it, as the fire whooshes through the whole cloud. And where a blast meets a pit, its cover breaks and whoever it throws in falls.
